name: ZOOM Kindermuseum
notes: Site has no central calendar; each program section (Ausstellung, Atelier, Ozean, Trickfilmstudio, Fragwuerdig/Kindervorlesungen) has one standing page describing whatever is currently on offer, parsed as a permanent record (extra.permanent=true). A couple of subpages (e.g. atelier-abos) carry a structured 'Laufzeit:' range or 'TERMINE' list of single dated slots, which become discrete dated occurrences instead. Server is very flaky/slow (JSESSIONID redirect dance, frequent multi-minute hangs on some requests) so scrape.py uses its own cookie-jar opener with a short per-request timeout and 2 retries; a page that never responds is silently skipped for that run rather than failing the whole scrape. Yield varies run to run (5-6 records seen) depending on which pages answer in time.
